Resets horizontal fine scroll, runs the title routine at $7D00, banks BASIC out, and initializes the car counter, score digits, level selector and play sound.
Clears round state with $19D9, starts with scroll step two, selects one of four track descriptors by $1DB7, sets up the display and HUD, and enables raster interrupts.
Stops CIA1 timer A, clears raster line bit 8, installs $0DC4 for line $24, and enables and acknowledges VIC raster interrupts.

Applies the road's extended background control and fine scroll and installs $0E30 for raster $36. The pause flag gates the accumulator update and group fetch. When the fetch runs it instead schedules $0E9F for raster $D2.
A single SEI byte sits between the top handler's tail jump and the fetch-request byte at $0E2F.
Set after $107C has consumed five columns. The top raster handler clears it after it fills the next column buffers.

Schedules $0E9F for line $D2 and latches the requested pause. Executes the first or third unrolled scroll section while a coarse shift is pending. On ordinary passes it reads the pause key and services gas, the secondary gauge and sound selection.

At line $D2 restores zero horizontal scroll and 40 columns for the dashboard. Reads the sprite-collision latch, runs the middle coarse scroll section or active play updates, publishes sprite positions, interprets object scripts, and ticks the sound effects driver.
The middle raster handler copies requested pause state here from $0F3A.
The middle handler sets this after the pause keycode. The foreground loop clears it after the resume keycode.
Initialized to zero by round reset. When equal to one, $0F20 bypasses the player input update.
Transfers the raster handler's exit to the KERNAL restore-and-return routine at $EA81.

Loops on the latched pause, crash and score-update flags. On pause it attenuates the SID until the resume key, and on a crash it decrements the on-screen car count unless the end-of-track flag redirects the path.
Three-byte DEC of remaining cars. The unlimited-lives menu and the in-game key combination can patch these instruction bytes.
Low operand byte of the life decrement at $0F60. The pause cheat can replace it with $EA.
High operand byte of the life decrement. The next instruction checks the updated car digit for underflow.
Masks off the bottom three SID volume bits. Waits for key code $03 in $C5, clears the requested pause and sets the three volume bits again.
One requests a low-place score increment. Other nonzero requests use the hundreds-place entry.
Clears the end and slot-zero completion flags, then advances the track selector. Loads the next track after the interlude or takes the ending branch when the selector reaches five.
Set when a road-band stream returns $FF. Selects the track-advance path when the completion flag arrives.

Calls $1EDE, then jumps back to the title and new-game setup.
Resets the stream index to one, sets the track-finish flag, halts the scroll, and starts scripts $1E and $1F for sprites zero and seven.
